_about: These are MY labels, not ground truth handed down from anywhere — they encode
the rubric in server.mjs CLASSIFIER_RUBRIC and should be argued with rather
than trusted. Disagreeing with one is a reason to edit this file.
The only metric that gates the rollout is PRECISION ON `small`: because the
classifier is downgrade-only, a wrong `medium` or `high` verdict changes
nothing at all, while a wrong `small` spends a real turn on a weaker model.
So a case labelled `small` that comes back `high` is a missed opportunity;
a case labelled `medium`/`high` that comes back `small` is a DEFECT.
`source: corpus` entries are real prompts taken verbatim from
to cover a boundary the corpus happens not to contain.
